request.description: The ops lead queue, newest first. Filters: `status` (repeat for several), `source` (key), `consentStatus` (`pending` is the consent queue for the backlog), `flag`, `segment`, `category`, `cityId`, `pincode`, `q` (a ref such as `LD-26-000123`, or part of the name), `createdFrom`, `createdTo`. Paginate with `cursor`. Contacts are not included. Staff only. Reading needs lead read access (ops lead, ops reviewer, compliance, support); changes need lead update access (ops lead, ops reviewer).
